metaDescription: Re-indent PHP code inside php tags by brace depth. HTML outside the tags, heredocs and comments are left alone. Free and private.
intro: Fixes indentation, blank lines and optionally line breaks in PHP code without sending it anywhere.
why:
Messy indentation hides the structure of PHP code, and minified or copy-pasted code is worse. A re-indenter gives you the block layout back quickly.

The tool reads your code with a small scanner that knows strings, comments and raw literals, so braces inside them are ignored. It then sets the indent from bracket depth and, if you ask, puts a line break after braces and semicolons. It is not PHP-CS-Fixer.
howTo: Paste PHP code, with or without HTML around it.
Pick the indent and line break mode.

faq.q: Is this the same as PHP-CS-Fixer?
faq.a: No. PHP-CS-Fixer and PHPCBF apply PSR-12 rules. This tool only re-indents and optionally breaks lines. Syntax of the test files was still accepted by php -l after breaking.

faq.q: Will it change what my code does?
faq.a: It only changes whitespace outside strings, comments and raw literals. Test results: the non-whitespace text was unchanged on all test files, and re-running the tool gave the same output. Review the diff anyway.
Wrapping needs a full parser. This tool does not have one.
No. Everything runs in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
